SELECT ts_code, trade_date, (close/pre_close-1.0)::float8
                            FROM main.stock_daily_price
                            WHERE ts_code=ANY(%s) AND trade_date> DATE '2025-06-16'
                              AND trade_date<=DATE '2025-12-15'
                              AND close IS NOT NULL AND pre_close>0 AND volume>0
